colosseumrules:
**Colosseums:**
Colosseums can be an alternative to partaking in gym challenges or contests in your setting, or an additional opportunity if either of those do exist in it. They are a spectator sport in its purest form. With trainers battling against each other in large arenas for fame, accolades and prizes.

Colosseum battles are usually double battles, with two trainers on each side using two Pokémon each. They follow a tournament bracket format, with 4 teams of 2 and their Pokémon entering, and competing for the final spot. Some colosseums may have an additional bout where the winners will face off against the Colosseums reigning champions. (The Storyteller may decide to run single or double battles, 1 Trainer per side, more Pokémon per Trainer etc for your setting however).

Colosseums work somewhat similarly to contests, having an entry fee, and using the same ranks: Normal, Super, Hyper and Master. Trainers may gain notoriety and higher standing when claiming victory. Also similarly, entrants may become stressed out or even break down completely during the fight, if their confidence is low or the crowd’s reactions are unfavourable.

**Confidence in the Arena:**
Confidence is an optional mechanic, but can add another layer of challenge. Certain reactions the crowd has to exciting, disappointing or boring moments during a bout will affect the trainers and Pokémon competing. Trainers and Pokémon can not exceed their usual maximum Confidence by any means.

__Knockouts:__
Whenever a Trainer’s Pokémon is knocked out they lose 2 Confidence.
Whenever a Trainer’s Pokémon knocks out a Foe they and their Pokémon gain 2 Confidence.

__Misses:__
If a Trainer’s Pokémon misses 3 times in a row the Trainer and their Pokémon lose 1 Confidence.

__Criticals:__
If a Trainer’s Pokémon Critically Fails, the Trainer and Pokémon lose 1 Confidence.
If a Trainer’s Pokémon lands a Critical Hit on a Foe, the Trainer and Pokémon gain 1 Confidence.

__Pain Penalties:__
A Trainer loses 1 Confidence for each Pain Penalty their Pokémon receives. (This stacks if the Pokémon used a Move to Heal, then went to Pain Penalties again etc).

__Underdog Victory:__
If a side wins their bout while only having only 1 Pokémon not knocked out. The Trainer whose Pokémon is left standing and that Pokémon gain 2 Confidence.

__Colosseum Field-Type:__
When a Move used gains +1 Additional Damage Dice from the Colosseum Field-Type the Trainer gains 1 Confidence.

**Stress Levels:**
These effects stack on top of each other, the less Confidence you have However, a Trainer may spend a Will Point to ignore a single Stress Penalization for themselves or their Pokémon, for one match. (Obviously this should be last resort, especially if you have more matches ahead!)

__Full Confidence:__
Emotional State: Confident. Stress Bonus: You need one less success to Critically Hit.

__Less Than Full Confidence:__
Emotional State: Locked In. Stress Bonus / Penalization: None.

__Half Confidence (Rounded Down):__
Emotional State: Nervous. Stress Penalization: You need 1 additional success to Critically Hit and one less failure to Critically Fail.

__One Confidence Remaining:__
Emotional State: Freaking Out. Stress Penalization: Roll every Damage Roll twice, keep the lowest.

__Zero Confidence:__
Emotional State: Breakdown. Stress Penalization: Pokémon refuse to fight. Trainers concede the match.

**Colosseum Ranks:**
These are the different ranks and their fees, likely difficulties, prizes, and benefits for victory. Trainers must have beaten a Colosseum of the previous rank to qualify for one of the next.
Note: Ignore the Notoriety Skills if you wish to. More info can be found in Pokerole 2.0 edition.

__Normal:__
Entry Fee per team: ₽2000.
Likely opponent ranks: Starter / Rookie / Standard.
Likely prize pool: ₽10000 / TMs / Evolution Items.
Accolades: Gain 1 Notoriety Skill Point / Limit 2.

__Super:__
Entry Fee per team: ₽5000.
Likely opponent ranks: Standard / Advanced.
Likely prize pool: ₽20000 / TMs / Mega Stones / Z-Crystals / Minor plot related item.
Accolades: Gain 2 Notoriety Skill Points / Limit 3.

__Hyper:__
Entry Fee per team: ₽10000.
Likely opponent ranks: Expert / Ace.
Likely prize pool: ₽50000 / Key Stone / Z-Bracelet / Master Ball.
Accolades: Gain 3 Notoriety Skill Points / Limit 4.

__Master:__
Entry Fee per team: ₽25000.
Likely opponent ranks: Ace / Master / Champion.
Likely prize pool: ₽100000 / Major plot related item / Anything from lower ranks.
Accolades: Gain 4 Notoriety Skill Points / Limit 5.
standardsofliving:
Starving:
₽0 Per Week.
Trainer and Team take a Level of Exhaustion, Trainer recovers 1 Stamina Point each day.

Impoverished:
₽350 Per Week.
Trainer and Team take a Level of Exhaustion each week. Trainer recovers 3 Stamina Points each day.

Surviving:
₽1000 Per Week.
Trainer and Team Heal 1HP, 1 Will Point and Trainer recovers their full Stamina Points -1 each day.

Decent:
₽2000 Per Week.
Trainer and Team Heal 4HP, 1 Will Point and Trainer recovers their full Stamina Points each day.

Living Well:
₽5000 Per Week.
Trainer and Team Heal 6HP, 2 Will Points and Trainer recovers their full Stamina Points each day.

Luxurious:
₽15000 Per Week.
Trainer and Team Heal 8HP, 3 Will Points and Trainer recovers their full Stamina Points +2 Bonus Point each day.
stabling:
Basic Stables:
₽500 Per Week.
Basic stables might not cost much, but your Pokémon may not like you if you leave them there for a long time, they wont receive any training or bonuses. At Storytellers discretion Pokémon may lose happiness or loyalty over time.

Decent Stables:
₽2000 Per Week.
While the level of care here is good, your Pokémon will not be living in luxury. For every week Pokémon are stored here they will gain 3 Training Point and 1 Will Point per week.
Roll a D100 Luck Check each week, on a 90+ an egg might be found!

Premium Stables:
₽8000 Per Week.
While your Pokémon stay here, they are cared for very well, services such as grooming, or training may be provided by these establishments. For every week Pokémon are stored here they will receive 5 Training Points and restore 3 Will Points. Their happiness may increase over time too at the Storyteller’s discretion.
Roll a D100 Luck Check each week, on an 80+ an egg might be found!
